# Kenney Input Prompts: Keyboard & Mouse

The keyboard and mouse font of Kenney's Input Prompts 1.5 (https://kenney.nl/assets/input-prompts), the release
`third_party/kenney_input` holds the controller fonts of, as released: CC0 (License.txt, the release's own).
`builder/rust/src/prompts/keys.rs` draws the keyboard face's keys from it.

- kenney_input_keyboard_&_mouse.otf (Keyboard & Mouse/Fonts)
